title: Involvement of EupR, a response regulator of the NarL/FixJ family, in the control of the uptake of the compatible solutes ectoines by the halophilic bacterium Chromohalobacter salexigens
figure_locator: Figure 1 caption; PMC element F1, panels A-D
methods_locator: Methods / Bacterial strains, plasmids and growth conditions

excerpts.carbon: 20 mM glucose, 20 mM ectoine, or 20 mM hydroxyectoine
excerpts.salt_basis: The osmotic strength of M63 was increased by the addition of a 0.6 to 2.5 M final concentration of NaCl.
excerpts.ectoine_basis: When used as the sole carbon sources, ectoine and hydroxyectoine (bitop AG, Witten, Germany) were added to the media at a final concentration of 20 mM.
excerpts.koh: The pH of all media was adjusted to 7.2 with KOH.
